Plex needs atlas (it runs as a Docker container there) and tank (library on tank/media, appdata on tank/appdata). The titan dependency is superseded history and does not count.

If titan is off, the Ollama endpoint on titan stops (direct). The wiki search service on hermes, which calls that endpoint for embeddings, degrades: new pages are not embedded but keyword search still works (second hop). The old titan link on Plex is superseded and ignored.
The nightly rclone backup needs atlas (the job runs there), tank (it reads the 05:45 tank snapshot) and gate (internet access to upload to the cloud remote).
The hermes VM needs atlas (it runs on and stops with atlas) and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains; it cannot boot without tank).

If atlas stops, the Syncthing container on atlas stops, so tank/notes no longer syncs to pebble (direct). Syncthing to pebble also runs only over Tailscale, which is an Unraid plugin on atlas, so that path is lost too (through Tailscale).

Direct (needs gate): the reverse proxy (outside access on 443), Tailscale (internet access), the nightly rclone backup (cloud upload), aria the AV receiver (network features), and atlas notifications (email agent). Second hop via Tailscale: Syncthing to pebble and pebble's remote access to hermes and Plex.

Directly it needs hermes (the VM it runs on). Indirectly, hermes needs atlas and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains), and atlas needs apc-1 for power. Keyword search still works without the Ollama endpoint on titan, which only affects embeddings for new pages.

If atlas shuts down, the ZFS pool tank stops (it exists only while atlas runs), and these need atlas directly: the hermes VM, Plex, the Caddy reverse proxy, Syncthing, the Tailscale plugin and the nightly rclone backup. Second hop: the wiki search service (needs hermes) and pebble's remote access (needs Tailscale).

If tank is unavailable with atlas running, these directly stop or fail: Plex (library and appdata), the hermes VM (cannot boot, its vdisk is on tank), Syncthing (notes sync) and the nightly rclone backup (snapshot). Second hop: the wiki search service (through hermes) and syncing to pebble (through Syncthing).

If hermes is down, the wiki search service (qmd) directly loses function and its nightly index rebuild stops, so the index goes stale. Second hop: the Caddy reverse proxy's wiki search front end is affected, and pebble cannot reach hermes remotely.
